mcq_fix.s: Which one of the following journals was NOT associated with Mahatma Gandhi?
mcq_fix.why: stem 'listed in this context' is odd; APPSC 2019 asks it plainly

mcq_drop.why: contrived A-R pairing two unrelated titles

patterns: Direct single facts: first satyagraha in South Africa 1906 (APPSC G1), return 1915, Pietermaritzburg, Indian Opinion and its first editor.
Hind Swaraj: year 1909, Gujarati, 'sterile' British Parliament; autobiography in Gujarati.
Newspaper odd-one-out items recur (Yugantar, Indian Mirror, Mathrubhumi not Gandhi papers).
Influences: Ruskin/Thoreau/Tolstoy 'all the above'; Unto This Last = good of individual in good of all.
Many filed PYQs are general-awareness strays; app items are on-topic and slightly deeper.
